clock.description: A clock made from another: a PLL or MMCM with the recipe its implementation's settings state, and optionally a fine phase shift stepped at run time.

fine_phase_shift.description: 1: the output's phase can be stepped finely at run time, through ps*.

stop_flags.description: 1: the clock says why it is not locked -- its input stopped, or its feedback did.

in_khz.description: The input's rate in kHz. 0: the node states its own.

out_khz.description: The output's rate in kHz, where the design derives it: the requested frequency is set from it. 0: the node states its own.

divclk.description: The recipe's input divider, where the design states a recipe.

mult8.description: The recipe's feedback multiplier, in eighths (297: 37.125): with in_khz, divclk and out_khz, an exact MMCM recipe, the output divider worked out from them (revela.boards.common.clocking). 0: the wizard chooses.

inputs.name: psclk
inputs.description: The clock the phase-shift handshake runs in.

inputs.name: psen
inputs.description: One step, in the direction psincdec gives.

outputs.name: psdone
outputs.description: The step requested has been made.

clk_wiz.description: AMD's clocking wizard. The frequencies follow in_khz and out_khz where the design gives them, and a recipe the design states is forced, not requested: asked for 74.250 the wizard lands 74.287, 490 ppm off and past a genlock's whole authority.
